nodes.name: AgentOrgFinalAudit.md
nodes.summary: Final full-scope architecture audit (in Chinese) for the Agent Org #272 recovery-invariants branch, covering Run/Task/Inbox/Wake/Watchdog, member lifecycle, Planner approval, task authority, desktop projection, and E2E; concludes no remaining P0/P1/P2 issues and clears the branch for merge.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Chinese; uses a ten-layer audit table format plus an invariant-recheck table and test verification results.

nodes.name: CanvasSessionState.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit of Canvas session state ownership across `canvasPreviewAtom`, `useCanvasForTurn`, and Canvas consumers in Chat, SessionCore, and WorkStation, verifying that session matching, dismiss/clear mutations, and pinned/simulator state have single, non-overlapping ownership after removing a compatibility hook.

nodes.name: SessionProvenance.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit of the Session Provenance PR spanning the extracted wire protocol, canonical Orgtrack records, hook CLI/installers, SQLite storage, historical transcript reconciliation, RPC schemas, and Session Blame sidebar UI, verifying naming, wire-format, and initialization-parity invariants across Claude/Codex/Cursor providers.

nodes.name: WarpImportedHistory.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit of the Warp imported-history feature (#366), covering read-only detection/import of Warp's local conversation database, reuse of the shared imported-history cache/replay pipeline, and separation from the unrelated Warp CLI/TUI integration tracked by #331.
